summary: BrainsWay Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting pilot study results via press release. The study, published in the Journal of Geriatric Psychiatry and Neurology, evaluated Deep Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (Deep TMS) in 12 patients with comorbid major depressive disorder and early-stage Alzheimer's disease. Results showed an 83.3% response rate and 50% remission in depressive symptoms, plus neurophysiological changes. This is a routine clinical update, not a special situation; no transactional or corporate event is involved.
